name: CS-said-alone
old: g.refused = (r.unknown ? CARD_STAKE_REFUSALS.unknown : CARD_STAKE_REFUSALS[r.error]) ?? 'The realm could not hold your stake - try again.'; say(g.refused);
new: say((r.unknown ? CARD_STAKE_REFUSALS.unknown : CARD_STAKE_REFUSALS[r.error]) ?? 'The realm could not hold your stake - try again.');

name: CS-kept-past-press
why: while the realm is asked the panel says 'The realm is holding your stake...' over any refusal, and every answer either writes its own refusal or leaves the buy-in for the game - so a refusal kept past the press is never shown; cleared all the same, so no later road back to the buy-in can show a stale one

name: CS-panel-ignores
old: staking ? 'The realm is holding your stake...' : refused ?
new: staking ? 'The realm is holding your stake...' : false ?
